name: Reported DHI bitcoin mining/data-center site near Trongsa
developer: Druk Holding and Investments / Green Digital Limited
notes: Forbes reported a bitcoin-mining facility on a road south of Trongsa and said satellite imagery showed rows of green-roofed units at the site; DCD summarized the Forbes investigation. DHI's company list identifies Green Digital Limited as established in 2023 to undertake mining of digital assets. Site capacity was not disclosed and exact operator/site details remain partly unverified.

name: GovTech Agency backup data center, Jakar
developer: GovTech Agency, Royal Government of Bhutan
notes: GovTech's Cloud Services Division says its mandate includes operating the primary Government Data Center at Thimphu TechPark and a backup data center in Jakar, Bumthang. No public capacity figure was found.
